about.pageSubtitle: Over 40 years of commercial heritage, 20+ years of industry expertise — your trusted partner

story.title: Our Story
story.p1: The Emrebas family story began in the 1980s with grain trading in Yozgat Yerköy. The commercial experience and entrepreneurial spirit passed down from father to son took on a new dimension when we stepped into the excavation and transportation sector in the early 2000s.
story.p2: Starting with a single truck and great determination, our company grew rapidly by responding to the region's increasing infrastructure needs. Our expansion into sand quarry and stone quarry operations in the 2010s made us one of the most comprehensive construction material suppliers in the region.
story.p3: Today, with over 40 years of commercial heritage and more than 20 years of industry experience, we provide excavation, sand and gravel production, transportation and construction services in Yozgat and surrounding provinces. From municipalities to solar power plant projects, from residential construction to infrastructure works — we are a reliable partner across a wide range of projects.
story.p4: At Emrebas, we combine the warmth of a family business with a professional service approach. In every project, we stand by our customers with our commitment to keeping our word and delivering reliable work.

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: To complete our customers' projects on time and within budget with quality materials and reliable service. To work with the highest standards of occupational safety and environmental awareness in every project.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: To be a pioneer in the industry with modern technology and our professional team as the largest and most reliable excavation and mining company in the region.

values.title: Our Values

values.qualityDesc: The highest quality standards in every project
